teachBack.purpose: Aeostara is the platform-agnostic, ASH-conformant base design for a self-healing JSON configuration engine. For Sigil it is the health and validation authority pin: the product's Aeostara gateway records the base v1.0.0 baseline, platform-branch isolation, and fail-closed artifact-health decisions, and any future Aeostara lifecycle work in Sigil must follow the base's mandatory platform-neutral lifecycle (observe, normalize, project JSON or configuration state, diagnose, classify, determine recoverability, generate a recovery plan, evaluate the policy gate, prepare backup, execute the approved plan, verify, then rollback, fallback, containment, or safe halt, then emit the diagnostic and audit chain).
teachBack.nonPurpose: Aeostara is not a runtime dependency of Sigil and authorizes no package or native target import. It does not own native iOS implementation (that is the platform/ios branch of flynn33/Aeostara-Mac-iOS), does not define Sigil's identity pipeline or glyph mathematics, and cannot modify ASH (ASH wins conflicts). Generic JSON diffing is not semantic truth, and recovery is never derived from CRUD repair operations. Field note: product.baselineCommit identifies the Sigil repository baseline for this record and is intentionally distinct from system.sourceCommit, which is the authority-container revision.
teachBack.productLocalImplementation: Sources/RFSigilAeostaraIntegration is the product-owned Aeostara integration module and service: SigilAeostaraIntegrationGateway records the baseline pin (release v1.0.0, commit 774b981ef2267a41c1b1a59497b2b0746a86f32b per the product evidence record), platform/ios provenance, product observations, and fail-closed healthDecision results (mutation disallowed, backup required before mutation, verification required after execution, operator review required). tools/sigil_guardrails preserves the platform-separation and baseline-pinning guardrails. evidence/phase1/source-authority-evidence.md and docs/ash-trace carry the conformance documentation.
teachBack.permittedExternalDependencies: none. The base profile allowedRuntimeProducts and allowedDevelopmentTools are both empty; Sigil consumes no Aeostara code.
teachBack.externalOnlyMaterials: All of flynn33/aeostara (specs, conformance, fixtures, ci, implementation_handoff, templates, branch profiles) and all of flynn33/Aeostara-Mac-iOS (platform implementation) remain external. Sigil cites the base pin and platform provenance by commit in product-owned evidence records; repository identifiers appear as citations only and never in dependency declarations.
teachBack.templateAndExampleUse: templates/platform_repo and implementation_handoff define downstream platform-repository obligations (pin the base version, map every interface to a native module, run the fixture vectors, produce conforming diagnostics and audit events, document deviations); Sigil consults them to keep its Aeostara gateway evidence honest. Fixture vectors and schema examples are verification material only and never enter runtime targets.
teachBack.conformanceProof: IntegrationGatewayTests assert the recorded baseline, provenance, and fail-closed health-decision behavior; the strict guardrails validator enforces that Aeostara usage remains baseline-pinned and platform-separated; the realization validator verifies this contract and the absence of prohibited acquisition against the product checkout.

Sigil models Aeostara-facing behavior in product-owned code and records conformance in product-owned documentation.

governance.rationale: Forsetti Agentic Edition governance is not selected for Sigil: the product repository declares no agentic-edition artifacts, project context, or task contracts, and this profile's governance mustApply flag is false. The Aeostara base repository's own governance and CI material govern the upstream repository, not Sigil product work. If Forsetti Agentic Edition governance is ever adopted, a separate governance contract (profile rfd.forsetti.agentic.1.1.0) must be added to the linked set before dependent work.
